thread:
emma-support: Heads-up — customer Acme Inc (acct acme-776) escalated. They ran a free-trial grant for 120 users via the grants API, but recipients still show 0 credits. Ticket CS-4821. They reported a 400 when applying the promo code: 

emma-support: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply -d '{"code":"SPRING26","account_id":"acme-776"}' 
Response: {"error":"PROMO_INVALID_START", "message":"redemption not active until 2026-05-01"}

ana-cs: Can you paste the original grant request ID and the API response payload? Any request ids/trace? Also please confirm which account IDs were targeted.

emma-support: Request ID: req_01G9XKQZ8. Grant payload attached in ticket: grant_type=free-trial, code=SPRING26, start_date=2026-04-01, end_date=2026-06-01, redemption_limit=100, target=acme-776. Customer says UI shows start_date 2026-05-01 though.

liam-ops: I checked promo-service config for campaign SPRING26 — looks like the admin UI save job had a bug. The persisted campaign row has start_date=2026-05-01 and redemption_limit=0. That explains both the invalid_start error and 0 grants.

liam-ops: quick dump: SELECT id, code, start_date, end_date, redemption_limit FROM promotions WHERE code='SPRING26'; --> (123, 'SPRING26', '2026-05-01', '2026-06-01', 0)

sara-eng: Thanks. Sounds like the UI is writing 0 when the field is left blank. We have a migration fix ready to enforce null->default and validation. I can push a hotfix to promo-service to interpret 0 as unlimited only if explicitly set.

ana-cs: Customer expects immediate fix and backfill for accounts that should've received credits. How many affected? Emma, any estimate from ticket attachments?

emma-support: Their grant request targeted 120 emails. I have the list. They are waiting on credits before onboarding tomorrow morning. High priority.

mike-product: Prioritize backfill. Approve a quick DB patch to correct start_date to 2026-04-01 and set redemption_limit=100, then run a backfill job for the 120 accounts. Keep me posted on risk.

db-admin: I can run an update+backfill. Proposed SQL: 

BEGIN;
UPDATE promotions SET start_date='2026-04-01', redemption_limit=100 WHERE code='SPRING26';
-- backfill ledger entries for grant req_01G9XKQZ8
INSERT INTO credits (account_id, amount, reason, promo_code, created_by)
SELECT account_id, 100 AS amount, 'promo-grant-backfill', 'SPRING26', 'db-admin' FROM grant_requests WHERE request_id='req_01G9XKQZ8';
COMMIT;

I will run this in the maintenance window in 15m unless you want me to proceed immediately.

liam-ops: We should deploy the UI validation fix first to avoid recurrence. sara-eng, can you cut the promo-service patch now? If deploy goes smooth, db-admin can run the backfill immediately after.

sara-eng: Deploying patch to promo-service -> will push v1.12.3 now. Tests passed locally.

deploy-bot: promo-service v1.12.3 deployed to staging (build 5482). Canary in prod started.
deploy-bot: promo-service v1.12.3 canary healthy. Rolling to remaining prod nodes.
deploy-bot: promo-service v1.12.3 rolled out to prod (6/6). No errors observed.

db-admin: Patch applied to DB and backfill completed for 120 accounts. Sample check: SELECT balance FROM credits WHERE account_id='acme-776-42'; -> 100

emma-support: Confirmed with customer: credits visible, promo now applies, they were able to onboard 32 users already. Customer happy, closing CS-4821 :thumbsup:

ana-cs: Follow-up action: ticket created for UI validation bug (ENG-2209). Assign to sara-eng. Also add automated smoke test for promo creation flow.

mike-product: Thanks team. Note for postmortem: ambiguous empty field UX + missing server-side validation. Small but high impact.
